# Dewan Shakil Akhtar

Personal site, portfolio, and blog for Dewan Shakil Akhtar.

Primary pages:
- https://mrdsa.dev/
- https://mrdsa.dev/blog
- https://mrdsa.dev/zepper (Zepper, his open-source browser for macOS)
- https://mrdsa.dev/llms.txt
- https://mrdsa.dev/rss.xml

About:
- Dewan Shakil Akhtar is a full-stack product engineer and builder.
- He is a Member of Technical Staff at Stellon Labs, a San Francisco-based YC S25 company.
- His current technical focus includes on-device AI, React Native SDKs, mobile product engineering, and full-stack systems.
- He has built and shipped products including SoyFin, NOOL work, Ledref, Coldpen, and React Native/AI experiments.
- Ledref and Coldpen are archived products; SoyFin is listed as past work, not current primary work.

Topics:
- on-device AI
- React Native SDKs
- mobile AI product design
- full-stack product engineering
- Next.js, Firebase, and small web tools
- Claude Code tooling and developer workflows
- learning ML and PyTorch on Apple Silicon
- startup/product engineering lessons
- build logs and engineering notes
- personal essays about building software

Content style:
- Human, practical, and reflective.
- Clear technical writing without hype.
- Prefers simple, useful software over noisy demos.
- Blog posts often combine engineering details with honest product judgment.
